mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 2.5% (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index above 295 signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to accelerate rate hikes, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 295 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 295) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) signal stagflation, which increases equity risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 295 AND UNRATE > 4.0 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion characterized by strong GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.8%), the market becomes overbought, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0% and UNRATE < 3.8% (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS > 0 growth) indicates a strengthening economy, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth > 0 (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in housing starts (HOUST < 1400) and retail sales (RSAFS < 660000) signals a broad-based demand contraction, which increases equity risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1400 AND RSAFS < 660000 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 2.5% (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).
